{{Top|leg}}
'''GalactiDroid Architecture''' was a source of standards for certain [[Droid/Legends|droid]] applications. The [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies]] [[Sure-Sight]] incorporated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] correction software that was compatible with second-degree droids that met their Class 2-B standards.
